items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: he later did quite a few things with Bob Hope. Bob Hope had this television show with Les Brown's band

ctx.x: Yeah, but any way he later did quite a few things with Bob Hope. Bob Hope had this television show with Les Brown's band, and Bill Farrow was the featured vocalist on there. Very fine singer though, you know, But in thinking about Benny Carter, I don't know whether I mentioned before that I did quite a few recordings with Benny. This for Bob Freedman. This is a guy from Florida who was a song writer, and he wrote so many tunes, and he wanted to hear them all on records, so he wanted them all

recorded, and he wanted Benny to do them. And so Benny assembled the musicians and he had just about everybody that was anybody in Los Angeles on this day. And Bob Freedman brought Flip Phillips from Florida with him to do these recordings. And it was just nice seeing Flip after so many years and it was -- we were doing these tapes during the Christmas season, and on one -- tapes, this album, rather.
